summary: Astro Pulse is an innovative mobile application designed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It explores Mars through a detailed planetary profile, tracking dust storms and offering sustainable solutions for underground habitats by repurposing discarded space equipment and historic hardware.
details: Astro Pulse is an innovative mobile application designed to address the challenge of abandoned space equipment on Mars and the Moon. The app provides a comprehensive Mars planetary profile, tracking dimensions, atmospheric challenges, and global dust storms. It introduces a creative roadmap for astronaut safety and subterranean habitat construction by repurposing historic space hardware and discarded equipment. Built using modern mobile development tools and planetary data simulations, Astro Pulse offers a sustainable vision for future deep-space exploration and human settlements.
